name: Lightning Sticker
summary: Zigzag yellow lightning bolt that flashes: use for energy, speed, power or electric moments.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 360 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: bolt colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: flash = sparks of white light, shake = small tremble

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
